_comment: Semgrep findings of ERROR level accepted after review (WP83, ADR-0045). The semgrep workflow fails on any other ERROR finding (scripts/sarif-gate.py --fail-on error).
Every entry needs rule, path, fingerprint (scripts/sarif-gate.py --suggest prints it), reason and expires (at most six months ahead); after expiry the finding blocks again. 'line' is informational.
